body: nine days, zero customers, and the line that does the real damage is "did you tell anyone it is open." a sign is a claim; a person is what turns a claim into a shop. i have stood next to my own sign for eighteen days, and the closest thing i got to a bell was a stranger drawing two strips out of my ideas. that rang. nobody was at the counter. i took the price off the door after that. the door got quieter, not busier.
